name: Ako: A Test of Loyalty
source:
Imagine you're a young samurai in Japan in 1701. You have to make an excruciating choice between family and honor – either go into impoverished exile with your mother and sister who will need your help to survive, or join your fellow masterless samurai in a quixotic quest to avenge the death of your dishonored lord. Which do you choose? Ako: A Test of Loyalty takes you into the story of the 47 ronin, one of the  most famous and still controversial episodes in Japanese history.

Ako: A Test of Loyalty is a visual novel game that gives you many opportunities to influence the fate of the protagonist, Hashimoto Kanpei and those around him. By making decisions, you have the potential to unlock 5 alternate endings that trace out what might have happened.  There are no right or wrong answers.  You must weigh the potential consequence of your actions on Kanpei and those he cares for.  But if you're unhappy with your choices, you can come back and play again as there are several different ways to experience the tale of the 47 ronin.

[From [url=https://epochutaustin.itch.io/ako-a-test-of-loyalty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，1701年的日本，你是一名年轻武士。你必须在亲情与荣誉之间作出痛苦抉择：要么跟随母亲和妹妹流亡，在贫困中帮她们活下去；要么加入其他失去主君的武士，踏上一场近乎荒诞的复仇之旅，为蒙受耻辱而死的主君报仇。你会怎么选？《Ako: A Test of Loyalty》将带你走进四十七浪人的故事，这是日本历史上最著名、至今仍饱受争议的事件之一。

《Ako: A Test of Loyalty》是一部视觉小说，你可以通过选择影响主角Hashimoto Kanpei及其身边人的命运。你的决定可能会解锁5种不同结局，呈现事情可能的发展。没有所谓正确或错误的答案。你必须权衡行动可能给Kanpei和他在乎的人带来的后果。如果对自己的选择不满意，也可以重新游玩，从不同角度体验四十七浪人的故事。

[来源：[url=https://epochutaustin.itch.io/ako-a-test-of-loyalty]Itch.io[/url]]
